Criteria.TestCondition: If NO flashing content is found, then this Test Condition DOES NOT APPLY (DNA). If flashing content IS found, then this test should be recorded as NOT TESTED.
Criteria.TesterComment: The Trusted Tester process records flashing content as Not Tested. According to our experimental flash analysis, this flashing fails WCAG 2.3.1. A video (analyzed at full screen): 14 flashes per second, 26,848 square pixels flashing at once (the limit is 21,824 in any 341 by 256 pixel area), light and dark flashing. Flashing like this can cause seizures; fix it so it flashes no more than three times a second, or keep the flashing area small. Because flashing was found, the page cannot meet the non-interference test (1.D).

Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: We could not finish this test, so a person needs to check it. "#html5_media_taq1g8u2ve" works with a mouse but can't be reached with the keyboard; please check whether something else on the page does the same thing. Only the first 40 elements were checked for menus that open when the mouse rests on them. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).
